label: Lever
terms_note: Postings API: public GET postings/<site>; POST apply needs the Postings API key. CV: pdf, doc, docx, txt, rtf, odt.

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** (public Postings API; apply POST needs the company's key).
auth: 1. GET is public (no key); CORS only from the company's own domains (server-side calls unaffected).
2. `POST …?key=APIKEY` needs a Postings API key generated by a Super Admin in the company's Lever integrations settings — not obtainable by a candidate.

endpoints.notes: filters `location`, `commitment`, `team`, `department`, `level`, `group`; posting: id, text, categories{location,commitment,team,department,level}, lists[], descriptionPlain, additionalPlain, hostedUrl, applyUrl, workplaceType, salaryRange, createdAt, country

name*, email*, resume (multipart only), phone, org, urls{GitHub,LinkedIn,…}, comments, silent, source, consent.marketing / consent.store (+ compliancePolicyId), cards / customQuestions ids; 429 above 2 POST/s

reference.limits: Application POSTs: 2 requests/second → `429`, may change without warning; the docs require queue + retry or redirecting to the hosted form. No GET limit published. - Published postings are public and 'may be scraped by third parties'. - Apply POST is for the company's own application form; it requires the company key and spam mitigation (captcha) is expected. Candidate-side apply → assist. Registry `api.apply: true` presumes an employer key.

config_fields.name: site
config_fields.help: The company's Lever site name (usually the company name without spaces), e.g. 'leverdemo' in https://jobs.lever.co/leverdemo.

config_fields.name: api_host
config_fields.help: Lever postings host for the site's instance: api.lever.co (global) or api.eu.lever.co (EU).

search.note: Lever Postings API for ONE company's site (config site): GET /v0/postings/SITE?mode=json&skip=X&limit=Y 'Fetch[es] published job postings'. location is Lever's exact location filter (case sensitive, matched against the posting's location category); the API does not 'Let you do full-text searches over open jobs', so query is not sent — filter client-side. id is the posting id (use it with get_posting); applyUrl, categories (commitment, team, department, allLocations), country (alpha-2), workplaceType, lists[], salaryRange.interval and createdAt (epoch milliseconds) are in raw.

get_posting.note: GET /v0/postings/SITE/POSTING-ID: 'Get the named job posting by id. The fields which are available are the same as the fields exposed by the list API'.

not_offered.me: The postings endpoints are public and keyless; there is no account endpoint to verify.
not_offered.apply: POST /v0/postings/SITE/POSTING-ID?key=APIKEY needs 'an API key, which a Super Admin of your account can generate' (the employer's key) and 'our API only accepts resumes in multipart form data mode'; candidates apply at the posting's applyUrl (Lever's hosted form).
not_offered.list_messages: The Postings API only lists postings and accepts applications; it has no messaging endpoints.

live_check.notes: verified against the public site palantir; all read tools answered, schema-valid, pagination advances
